findings.title: Missing Model Router call log file

evidence.observation: call_log_exists is reported as false while the service is active and running

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router process has write permissions and automatically initializes the call log file to record routing events.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and auditing for model routing performance, latency, and failure tracking.

findings.title: Direct external LLM invocation bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct call to call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable rather than delegating through the Model Router service

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM inference calls through the Model Router to enforce uniform routing, fallback policies, and logging.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model routing, enables fallback capabilities, and enforces unified observability across intelligence operations.
